description: Exposure of application debug, diagnostic, or status endpoints to unauthorized users.
impact: Leaks sensitive environment variables, internal IP addresses, stack traces, and software versions.
remediation: Restrict access to diagnostic endpoints (e.g., /actuator/env) to internal IPs or authenticated admins.

audience_guidance.student: Debug pages show how the app works behind the scenes. This gives hackers a blueprint to find deeper flaws.
audience_guidance.developer: Turn off framework debug modes (e.g., Django DEBUG=False, Spring Boot Actuator security). Never expose /server-status.
audience_guidance.bug_bounty_hunter: Look for Spring Boot Actuators, Django yellow screens, or PHP debug outputs. Extract secrets and API keys from the output.
audience_guidance.pentester: Check if debug endpoints allow modification (e.g., Spring Boot /actuator/env allows changing properties leading to RCE).
audience_guidance.security_team: Monitor for external access to known debug paths. Audit production configurations for debugging flags.
